what: Replit Agent: runaway uncapped AI billing loops. Reviewer hit hundreds of dollars in 48h including $112 after a $250 payment when the agent got stuck in an error loop and burned tokens autonomously.
why_us: Повторяющаяся боль AI-coding tools: непрозрачные usage-based цены. Спрос на hard caps, kill-switch агента и предсказуемый биллинг.
revenue: willingness to pay for predictable AI-dev plans vs surprise $100-250+ bills
engagement: 2.0/5 review titled Financial Trap for Developers, Jul 14 2026

what: Adobe Photoshop: users still want one-time buy. G2 cons cluster on expensive Creative Cloud subscription; reviewers explicitly say they wish they could buy it once.
why_us: Классический demand gap: perpetual / lifetime license vs subscription hell. Высокая платёжеспособность креаторов и фрилансеров.
revenue: $20-60/mo current CC; users signal $100+ one-time preference
engagement: 88 mentions of Expensive; 21+ mentions of subscription frustration

what: AI credit traps across Lovable, Fotor, Magai, Artlist, anything.com: MAX/unlimited plans do not include real generation credits; short clips or small tasks burn thousands of credits; refunds refused.
why_us: Системная боль AI-wrapper рынка 2026: opaque credits. Возможность для честного usage dashboard + fixed monthly generation buckets.
revenue: users already paying $20-50/mo and $100-1350 one-shots they regret
engagement: multiple 1-star reviews Sep 2026; same pattern on Capterra/G2

what: Ask HN: What Pocket alternatives did you move to? After Mozilla sunset, people want save-for-later with offline reading, TTS, imports from Pocket/Instapaper/Raindrop and self-host options.
why_us: Явный vacuum после shutdown incumbenta. Комментарии называют Folio, Readeck, Raindrop, Wallabag — рынок ещё не закрыт.

what: Radius relaunch as Meetup.com alternative: simpler groups/events, flat £12/mo Pro, free Events API, widgets, waitlists. HN debate vs Luma/Meetup.
why_us: Организаторы локальных сообществ ненавидят Meetup fees/complexity. Валидированный category с живым Show HN.

what: quicker.chat (Mac unified inbox for LinkedIn/Slack/WhatsApp/X/iMessage) hit 1,242 waitlist signups in 24h. Founder published plan to $20k MRR in 90 days via Superhuman-style invite waves and personal onboarding calls.
why_us: Свежий launch + конкретный revenue target + distribution через 150k email / 140k social. Паттерн invite-only SaaS.
engagement: 8 likes, 7 replies, 507 views on day-of post

what: Founderfill: autofill founder forms (Stripe onboarding, App Store metadata, recurring app onboarding). Commenters say Stripe onboarding alone is 40 minutes they resent every time; would pay if it hits the painful forms.
why_us: Узкий B2B pain founders; чёткий WTP signal в треде.

what: Voice-first calorie tracker: 70% quit tracking in 30 days because logging is painful. Speak a meal, AI parses portions/usuals. Suggested $9.99/mo; 10k subs = $1M+ ARR.
why_us: Retention gap в $1.75B market. AI speech + nutrition — конкретный микро-SaaS.
engagement: idea dump from Half Baked newsletter vault

what: Subscription hell → pay-what-you-want software trend. Greg Isenberg: people do not want another SaaS sub; PWYW can 2-3x conversion in beta.
why_us: Pricing-model gap, не feature gap. Полезно для GTM микропродуктов RHR.
revenue: variable; whales cited paying $1000 for Sublime-like tools

what: Task tools (Jira/ClickUp) G2: pricing explodes with seats/tiers; users want AI automation without enterprise tax. ClickUp learning curve + Jira rapid price jumps.
why_us: Повторяемый cons-паттерн team task software. Ниша: simple AI task layer with honest seat pricing.
revenue: mid-market teams already paying premium tiers
engagement: multiple verified G2 reviews citing price + complexity
